The '''Biitu system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Tadrin sector/Legends|Tadrin subsector]] of the [[Cassander sector/Legends|Cassander sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]<ref name="EAOC" /> that contained at least two [[Planet/Legends|planets]], including [[Biitu]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Biituian]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="The Great Heep" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Biitu system first appeared, albeit unidentified, in "[[The Great Heep]]," a television movie that aired as part of the ''[[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO]]'' animated series,<ref name="The Great Heep" /> which originally aired on [[June 7]], [[1986]].<ref name="The Great Heep air date">{{InsiderCite|27|A Star Wars CELibration|A ''Star Wars'' CELibration}}</ref> It was later identified in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a reference book written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> and released on [[August 18]], [[2009]],<ref name="TEA release date">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/185066/the-essential-atlas-star-wars-by-daniel-wallace-and-jason-fry|text=The Essential Atlas: Star Wars}}</ref> which placed the system in grid square K-5.<ref name="TEA" />
